packs.name: Sunset Highlife Keys
packs.description: Warm afrobeats and afro-swing keys: major 7 and minor 9 loops, sunny two-chord vamps and soft sus turnarounds at 98 to 115 BPM.

packs.name: Log Drum Lounge
packs.description: Jazzy amapiano chords for log-drum grooves: dorian 13ths, minor 11ths and altered dominants at 110 to 115 BPM.

packs.name: Perreo Nocturno
packs.description: Reggaeton and latin trap harmony: minor i-VI-III-VII colors, Andalusian descents with extensions and dark harmonic-minor loops.

packs.name: Paper Heart Tapes
packs.description: Sad, open, guitar-shaped voicings for emo rap: add9 and sus chords, slash-bass walkdowns and borrowed minor iv sighs.

packs.name: Skyline Anthems
packs.description: Bright radio pop rap progressions with inspiring lifts, maj9 color and the borrowed minor iv that makes a hook feel bigger.

progressions.title: Harmattan Glow
progressions.description: IVmaj9 to iii7 to vi9, then a quick ii9 into a C13sus4 that never fully resolves. Bounce it under a shaker and the loop feels like late afternoon.

progressions.title: Marina Drift
progressions.description: A sunny two-chord vamp between IVmaj9 and iii7, with a suspended V that tightens into Eb7 at the very end to pull the loop round.

progressions.title: Okada Rooftop
progressions.description: Cmaj9 slides to Bm7 and a passing E7b9 that pushes hard into Am9, then D13 rides the bar out. Stab it on the offbeats for afro-swing bounce.

progressions.title: Palm Wine Fade
progressions.description: Eight bars of IVmaj7, iii7, vi9 and ii9, then the second half swaps in F#7b13 as a secondary dominant into Bm11. Rolled like a palm-wine guitar.

progressions.title: Lekki Sunday
progressions.description: Long two-bar chords for a slow afro-swing record: IVmaj9, iii7, vi9 and a suspended II that opens into F#13. Leaves plenty of room for a vocal.

progressions.title: Gold Coast Sway
progressions.description: A I-to-ii vamp that climbs through Bbmaj9 over D into a lydian Ebmaj7#11. The bass walks up while the top barely moves, so it loops forever.

progressions.title: Swing Daydream
progressions.description: Fmaj9 steps down through Em9 and Dm9, then a borrowed Fm6 darkens the last bar before G13sus4. Push the chords an eighth early for afro-swing lilt.

progressions.title: Lagoon Bounce
progressions.description: IVmaj9, iii7, ii11 and a suspended V that never lands on the I, so the loop keeps floating. The short top hook sits on E the whole way.

progressions.title: Danfo Lights
progressions.description: The classic IV-iii-vi descent dressed as maj9, m7 and m9, with a ii9 to Bb13 turnaround. Great on a Rhodes with light stabs.

progressions.title: Coastal Ember
progressions.description: A minor afrobeats loop: i9, VImaj9, III6/9 and a suspended VII that opens into B13. Warm but a little wistful.

progressions.title: Ankara Sunlight
progressions.description: Emaj7#11 gives way to E over F#, the soft gospel-style dominant, then Bmaj9 over D# and G#m9. All the movement is in the bass.

progressions.title: Highlife Breeze
progressions.description: Minor highlife color: i9, VImaj9, iv11 and a D7#9 with real bite. Arpeggiate it like a palm-wine guitar line over a held bass.

progressions.title: Shebeen Velvet
progressions.description: Dorian i9 to IV13, then Dbmaj9 and an altered C7b9. The second pass ends on a ii-V of Gm7b5 and C7#9 for a jazzy log-drum turnaround.

progressions.title: Log Drum Dusk
progressions.description: i9 to a dorian G13, then a lydian Bbmaj7#11 falling into A7b13. Short stabs over the log drum keep space for the bass.

progressions.title: Kasi Twilight
progressions.description: Bbm11 to Ebm9 and Gbmaj9, then F7sus4 cracks open into F7b9. A soulful pianistic loop that suits pulsing eighths.

progressions.title: Soweto Silk
progressions.description: Eight bars: i9, iv11, VImaj9 and B7b9, then a brighter second half through Gmaj9 and Cmaj7#11 to an augmented B7#5 that settles to B7.

progressions.title: Midnight Taxi Rank
progressions.description: Uneven chord lengths give this one its swing: six beats of Cm9, a quick Fm9, six beats of Abmaj7 and a short G7b9 kick back to the top.

progressions.title: Jozi Afterparty
progressions.description: i9, iv9, then a fast VImaj7 to E7#9 before resolving to Am11. The #9 gives it that bluesy amapiano grit.

progressions.title: Marimba Smoke
progressions.description: Two-bar chords for marimba or soft keys: i9, iv9, VImaj9 and a suspended V that resolves its sus into C#7b9.

progressions.title: Blue Lounge Steps
progressions.description: A dorian i11 to IV13 move, then down to VIImaj9 and an altered D#7b9. Deep and jazzy under a rolling log drum.

progressions.title: Dembow Neon
progressions.description: The reggaeton i-VI-III-VII as Am9, Fmaj7, Cmaj9 and G6/9. The bounce rhythm lines up with the dembow, and the top line follows the 3-3-2.

progressions.title: Malecon Heat
progressions.description: i9, VImaj9, IIImaj7, then a suspended VII and a harmonic-minor A7b9 that snaps back to Dm9. Smooth enough for a romantic perreo.

progressions.title: Faro Rojo
progressions.description: An Andalusian descent with extensions: Em9, D6/9, Cmaj7 and a flamenco-flavored B7b9. Push it an eighth early against the dembow.

progressions.title: Humo de Playa
progressions.description: Eight bars: i-VI-III-VII in maj9 and 13sus4 colors, then a second half that turns through Abmaj7#11 and Fm9 to G7b13 for the drop.

progressions.title: Toque de Queda
progressions.description: i11, VImaj7, iv9 and a harsh D7#9. Short stabs leave space for the dembow and make the #9 hit hard.

progressions.title: Lunar Perreo
progressions.description: i9, VImaj9, iv11 and a harmonic-minor F#7b9. The top line answers on the same syncopation every bar.

progressions.title: Rosa Callejera
progressions.description: A rare major reggaeton loop: Imaj9, vi9, IVmaj7 and a suspended V that resolves into Bb7. Good for a romantic, sunny record.

progressions.title: Calor Lento
progressions.description: Slow reggaeton: two bars each of F#m9 and Dmaj9, then Aadd9 and Eadd9 lead into a C#7sus4 that releases into C#7b9.

progressions.title: Navaja Fria
progressions.description: i9, a lydian VImaj7#11, iv11 and the harmonic-minor G#7b9. Cold piano over half-time drums.

progressions.title: Barrio Eclipse
progressions.description: Starts on a minor-major ninth for that spy-movie tension, then Dbmaj7, Bbm9 and C7b9 from F harmonic minor. Arp it over an 808.

progressions.title: Sombra Dorada
progressions.description: i9 to VImaj7, then a quick iv11 to F7#9 and back to Bbm11. Short stabs keep it menacing.

progressions.title: Cristal Oscuro
progressions.description: Eight cinematic bars: i9, VImaj7#11, iv9 and D#7b13, then a minor-major i that heads back into D#7b9.

progressions.title: Reina del Humo
progressions.description: i11, VImaj7#11 and a minor ii half-diminished F#m7b5 into B7b13. A dark minor ii-V under a trap pulse.

progressions.title: Ultima Bala
progressions.description: Harmonic-minor color all the way: Am(maj9), Fmaj7#11, Dm9, then E7b9 shifting to E7#9 for a nasty last bar.

progressions.title: Ghost on Repeat
progressions.description: vi-IV-I-V made sad and open: C#m9, Aadd9, Eadd9, then Bsus4 resolving over D# so the bass climbs back to C#.

progressions.title: Hoodie Weather
progressions.description: F#m11, Dmaj7, Aadd9 over C#, then Esus4 to E over G#. The bass walks F# - D - C# - E - G# like a fingerpicked guitar.

progressions.title: Paper Lungs
progressions.description: Two-bar chords for a 150 BPM half-time beat: Bm7add11, Gmaj7, Dadd9 over F#, then Asus2 and A over C#.

progressions.title: Static Halo
progressions.description: Em9, Cadd9, Gadd9 over B, then the borrowed Cm6 over Eb. The minor iv makes the loop ache every time it comes round.

progressions.title: Last Text Unread
progressions.description: Eight bars of open, guitar-style arps: Am9, Fmaj9, Cadd9 over E, Gsus4 and G over B. Perfect under a 140 half-time drum loop.

progressions.title: Faded Polaroid
progressions.description: vi9, IVadd9, Iadd9 over D# and a suspended V that never resolves. Wistful and unfinished on purpose.

progressions.title: Rain on the Ferry
progressions.description: Dm9, Bbmaj9, Fadd9 over A, then a borrowed Bbm6 and C7sus4. The Db in the top line is the tear in the eye.

progressions.title: Empty Passenger Seat
progressions.description: vi11, IVmaj9, Iadd9 over G, then Bbsus4 to Bb over D. A late-night drive in four bars.

progressions.title: Midnight Voicemail
progressions.description: Minor emo loop for a fast half-time beat: Cm(add9), Abmaj7, Ebadd9, then Bbsus2 and Bb over D climbing back to C.

progressions.title: Sleepless Satellite
progressions.description: Slow and floating: Gm9, a lydian Ebmaj7#11, Bbadd9, then Fsus4 to F over A leading back to G.

progressions.title: Fading Taillights
progressions.description: Am(add9), Fmaj7, Cadd9 over G and a dorian Dsus2 over F# before an Esus4 that leaves the question open.

progressions.title: Cracked Screen Glow
progressions.description: vi9, IVmaj7, Iadd9 over D, then the borrowed Ebm6 and F7sus4. Bittersweet, like a happy memory going sour.

progressions.title: Ashen Echoes
progressions.description: vi9, IVmaj9, Iadd9 over C and a suspended Eb7. Soft, held and heavy on the heart.

progressions.title: Victory Lap Lights
progressions.description: Cadd9, Fmaj7, Am9, then the borrowed Fm6 and G13sus4. The Ab-to-A in the top line is the lift into the next hook.

progressions.title: Rooftop Toast
progressions.description: Imaj9, iii7, IVmaj9 and a full bar of borrowed Cm6. Bright, then bittersweet, then back to the top.

progressions.title: Window Down Summer
progressions.description: Eight bars of summer: Dmaj9, F#m7, Gmaj9 and A13sus4, then Bm9, F#m7 over A, Gmaj7 and a borrowed Gm6 to come home.

progressions.title: Big Dreams Avenue
progressions.description: Abadd9 walks down over G to Fm9, then Dbmaj7 turns to Dbm6. The classic inspiring descent with a borrowed sigh at the end.

progressions.title: Gold Medal Morning
progressions.description: Emaj9, B over D#, C#m9, then Amaj7 to Am6. The bass steps down and the minor iv makes the loop feel earned.

progressions.title: Hometown Parade
progressions.description: Bbmaj9 lifts to C over Bb, falls to Am7 and Dm9, then a C9sus4 loops it back. That C over Bb is the uplift.

progressions.title: Open Sky Lift
progressions.description: Two-bar chords: Bbmaj9, Dm7, Ebmaj9, then a borrowed Ebm6 and F13sus4. The Gb to G at the end is the big lift into the hook.

progressions.title: Headline Sunrise
progressions.description: Iadd9, iii7, IVmaj9 and a V13sus4 that keeps the loop rising without resolving. Clean radio piano.

progressions.title: Main Stage Glow
progressions.description: vi9, IVmaj9, Iadd9 over G and Bb13sus4. A big, bright stadium loop for a hook.

progressions.title: First Class Window
progressions.description: Imaj9, iii7, IVmaj9, then a borrowed Bm6 and C#13sus4. Smooth and expensive sounding.

progressions.title: Pocket Full of Sun
progressions.description: Dbmaj9, Fm7, a lydian Gbmaj7#11, then the same root turns minor as Gbm6. Warm with a touch of nostalgia.

progressions.title: Comeback Season
progressions.description: vi9, IVmaj9, Imaj9 over D#, then a ii9 to F#13 turnaround. Triumphant with a soulful finish.

progressions.title: Daylight Anthem
progressions.description: Eight bars: Cmaj9 to D over C, Bm7 and Em9, then Am9, Gmaj9 over B, a borrowed Cm6 and D13sus4 to launch the hook again.
